name: Barclay
source:
A butler who works for the Ashfords. A kind superior, he is also like a father to [url=https://vndb.org/c43388]Nathan[/url]. He is the person who knows what actually happened 15 years ago.

[From [url=http://www.roseverte.net/cafe0/beast/en]Official Website's Characters Page[/url]]
